environment.reproduction: Install existing test dependencies with cd tests && npm ci; from the repository root run node docs/team-page-options/verify-previews.cjs --ready. TEAM_PREVIEW_PLAYWRIGHT may point to an existing playwright-core installation; TEAM_PREVIEW_ROOT and TEAM_PREVIEW_PORT are optional overrides.
environment.fonts: Original local Barlow, Barlow Condensed and Caveat faces
environment.taskCount: Native picker open + option choice count as two tap-equivalent actions; scroll and typing excluded. Save includes acknowledgement.
